mentions.name: Weejur
mentions.description: This is a website publishing platform aimed at making it easy for non-technical folks to publish websites. 82 sites have been published so far with a wide range of content, and a simple WYSIWYG website editor is in development to complement the current functionality.
mentions.problem: Publishing websites is difficult for non-technical people.
mentions.audience: Non-technical people who want to publish websites
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm trying to make it easier for non-technical folks to publish websites: https://weejur.com

82 sites published so far, with a really weird and wide range of content.

Working on a simple WYSIWYG website editor to go with the current functionality.
